taskChanges.newValue: Removed reload-game action and activeTab permission; popup Refresh from log only replays local storage. Added persisted captureSettings with independent interceptEnabled/logEnabled. MAIN hook starts disabled until isolated bridge sends settings, bypasses fetch/XHR while off, and background rechecks settings before cache/log writes. Log off retains cache updates. Updated guide and generated data catalog. npm run check: 23/23 pass, build 0.2.1 and docs generation pass; Knowns validation passes. System Decision Impact: candidate @decision/20261101-1703-passive-rpc-capture-with-independent-intercept-and-log-switches (changed); prior reload-game draft rejected. Chrome smoke test remains.
